verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page offers a first-party option to keep an organization's data out of AI model training, so the capability is direct. It is enterprise-only and arranged through an account manager rather than a self-serve setting. Community evidence (otter-comm-6) indicates recordings are used, anonymized, as training data by default, which is consistent with an opt-out existing only at the enterprise tier and does not contradict it. Missing for 10: a self-serve opt-out for individual or non-enterprise users, documentation of the opt-out's scope and mechanics, and independent confirmation that excluded data is actually withheld from training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Keep your organization's data out of AI model training. Contact your account manager to get started.
